channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Japanese Yen struggles below 159.00 vs USD amid fiscal woes, US-Japan rate gap
item.description: The USD/JPY pair reverses an intraday dip to sub-159.00 levels and climbs to the top end of its daily range during the early part of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Equities: Risk sentiment holds despite oil and rates – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists report that US equities saw modest losses as Oil extended gains, with the S&P 500 easing slightly from record highs and chipmakers leading declines. Energy and health care outperformed.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD corrects lower from $67.00 resistance area
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades lower on Tuesday, retreating to levels below $64.50, after rejection at seven-week highs around $66.60 on Monday.

item.title: British Pound: Upside tests but capped near 1.3555 against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that GBP/USD extended last week’s rally, but overbought conditions should confine intraday moves to a 1.3490–1.3535 band.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as market caution lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8110 during the early European hours on Tuesday. The currency pair has pushed higher as the US Dollar (USD) erased its intraday losses, fueled by a sharp rally in crude oil driven by heightened geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ tightening key to recovery against US Dollar - OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that Japan’s recent FX intervention, backed by United States (US) involvement, has not fully reversed Japanese Yen (JPY) weakness, with USD/JPY near 159 after retracing much of its post-intervention drop.

item.title: Oil: Upside risks persist as deal optimism fades – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices are firmer as optimism over a potential US–Iran deal fades, keeping supply risks elevated.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Refreshes weekly high at $82.70 as oil supply uncertainty deepens
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 1.55% higher at around $82.70 during the European trading session on Tuesday, the highest level seen in over a week.

item.title: British Pound consolidates around 1.3500 vs USD; looks to US CPI, UK GDP for fresh impetus
item.description: The GBP/USD pair seesaws between tepid gains and minor losses through the early European session on Tuesday, though it remains close to the highest level since July 16 set the previous day.

item.title: Euro drifts below 1.1550 as hopes of a swift US-Iran peace deal wane
item.description: The Euro (EUR) nudges lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, weighed by the stalemate in the US-Iran negotiations and higher oil prices, which put additional pressure on the crude-importing eurozone economies.

item.title: Forex Today: Fading hopes of a US-Iran deal weighs on market mood
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Tuesday, August 11:

item.title: Australian Dollar: RBA holds rates but downside bias persists – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur reports that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) left interest rates unchanged in a unanimous decision, with forecasts showing higher unemployment and lower short-term inflation.

item.title: Euro: Gains capped below key resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note EUR/USD has stalled after last week’s surge, with flat momentum pointing to a 1.1530–1.1560 intraday range.

item.title: Indian Rupee falls Trump's war compensation demand lifts oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a cautious note against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair rises further to near 95.40 as surging oil prices due to escalating fears of a prolonged global supply disruption have weakened the Indian currency.

item.title: Gold pulls back from June 5 high, slides below $4,400 amid inflation-driven Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retreats from its highest level since June 5, touched earlier this Tuesday, and slides back below the $4,400 mark heading into the European session.

item.title: RBA Governor discusses policy path after keeping interest rates steady
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock is speaking at the press conference, explaining the reasons behind leaving the benchmark interest rate unchanged at 4.35% after the August monetary policy meeting.Bullock is taking questions from the press as part of a new reporting format int

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Aussie spikes down below 0.7050 as RBA’s Bullock speaks
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) has reacted with moderate declines against the US Dollar (USD) following Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Michelle Bullock's speech on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar declines against New Zealand Dollar following RBA decision
item.description: AUD/NZD pares its daily gains, trading around 1.1960 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) has drifted lower following the Reserve Bank of Australia’s (RBA) latest monetary policy decision, keeping the currency cross on a weaker footing.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah stays under pressure as Retail Sales YoY decline in June
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 17,850 during the Asian hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar dips after RBA's on-hold decision as traders eye post-meeting presser
item.description: The AUD/USD pair slides below mid-0.7000s after the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) announced its policy decision, though it lacks follow-through.

item.title: Australian Dollar falls sharply against Yen after RBA’s monetary policy decision
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) faces selling pressure against its major currency peers, trading 0.15% lower at around 112.20 against the Japanese Yen (JPY) during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Tuesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Remains below 183.00 as bearish bias prevails
item.description: EUR/JPY depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 183.80 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The Relative Strength Index (14) at 47.63 sits just below the neutral 50 line, hinting at ongoing bearish momentum without yet reaching oversold conditions.

item.title: British Pound clings to gains against US Dollar, US CPI in focus
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) holds onto two-day gains marginally at around 1.3500 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar sits near two-month top vs USD amid bullish oil prices
item.description: The USD/CAD pair is seen consolidating its recent losses to a two-month low, touched last week, and trading below mid-1.3900s during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen holds range in thin holiday trading amid intervention speculations
item.description: USD/JPY moves little after posting nearly 1% gains in the previous day, trading around 159.30 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair moved little today, trading in tight ranges as market volumes remained thin with Japanese markets closed for the Mountain Day holiday.

item.title: BoJ to consider raising interest rates in September – Jiji Press
item.description: According to the Jiji Press, the Bank of Japan (BoJ) may consider an additional interest rate increase at its next policy meeting on September 17-18, after leaving them unchanged in July, to counter upside inflation risks.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains confined in a range vs USD amid Iran risks, ahead of US CPI
item.description: The NZD/USD pair seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Tuesday and currently trades just below the 0.5900 mark.

item.title: Euro flat lines near mid-1.1500s vs USD as traders await US CPI amid Iran uncertainty
item.description: The EUR/USD pair struggles to gain any meaningful traction and holds steady around the 1.1545-1.1550 area during the Asian session on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds ground ahead of RBA policy decision
item.description: AUD/USD regains ground after registering modest losses the previous day, trading around 0.7060 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair gains as the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains stronger ahead of the Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) interest rate decision later in the day.
